verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for a tax agency's digital services, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing web portals (Online Services, Web File, Quick Pay), and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The mention of 'approved software' filing is an adjacent channel with no documented API in the pack, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
